unit_cn: Unit 4 Natural Disasters 自然灾害
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 4 词表(p122-123 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、自然灾害主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: An earthquake is a terrible natural disaster.
words.example_cn: 地震是一种可怕的自然灾害。

words.example_en: A powerful tornado swept through the town.
words.example_cn: 一场强龙卷风席卷了小镇。

words.example_en: The long drought destroyed most of the crops.
words.example_cn: 长期干旱毁掉了大部分庄稼。

words.example_en: The flood covered the streets with water.
words.example_cn: 洪水把街道淹没在水中。

words.example_en: The earthquake caused a huge tsunami.
words.example_cn: 这场地震引发了巨大的海啸。

words.example_en: The quake reached a magnitude of 7.8.
words.example_cn: 这次地震达到了7.8级。

words.example_en: Rescue workers dug people out of the ruins.
words.example_cn: 救援人员把人们从废墟中挖出来。

words.example_en: The storm caused great damage to the village.
words.example_cn: 风暴对村庄造成了巨大破坏。

words.example_en: The earthquake destroyed almost every building.
words.example_cn: 地震几乎摧毁了每一栋建筑。

words.example_en: The police evacuated the people from the area.
words.example_cn: 警方将人们从该地区疏散。

words.example_en: Workers built shelters for the survivors.
words.example_cn: 工人们为幸存者搭建了避难所。

words.example_en: Only a few people survived the disaster.
words.example_cn: 只有少数人在灾难中幸存。

words.example_en: Food and water were brought to the survivors.
words.example_cn: 食物和水被送到幸存者手中。

words.meaning_cn: 震惊;令人震惊的事;休克;(使)震惊
words.example_en: People stood in shock as they looked at the ruins.
words.example_cn: 人们望着废墟,震惊得说不出话。

words.example_en: In one minute the whole city lay in ruins.
words.example_cn: 一分钟之内整座城市变成了废墟。

words.example_en: Fallen bricks covered the ground like red leaves.
words.example_cn: 掉落的砖块像红叶一样铺满地面。

words.example_en: The railway tracks became useless pieces of metal.
words.example_cn: 铁轨变成了无用的金属碎片。

words.example_en: Soldiers dug out those who were trapped.
words.example_cn: 士兵们把被困的人挖了出来。

words.example_en: They worked hard to bury the dead with respect.
words.example_cn: 他们尽力庄重地安葬逝者。

words.example_en: Slowly, the city began to breathe again.
words.example_cn: 慢慢地,这座城市又开始呼吸了。

words.example_en: Tangshan started to revive itself after the quake.
words.example_cn: 地震后唐山开始重新振作。

words.example_en: In times of disaster, people must unify.
words.example_cn: 在灾难时刻,人们必须团结一致。

words.example_en: The people showed great wisdom in rebuilding.
words.example_cn: 人们在重建中展现了非凡的智慧。

words.example_en: People who suffered the quake needed help.
words.example_cn: 遭受地震的人们需要帮助。

words.example_en: The couple lived near an active volcano.
words.example_cn: 这对夫妇住在一座活火山附近。

words.example_en: They volunteered to help after the volcano erupted.
words.example_cn: 火山爆发后他们主动帮忙。

words.example_en: A strong typhoon hit the coast last summer.
words.example_cn: 去年夏天一场强台风袭击了海岸。

words.example_en: Most buildings damaged by the hurricane were repaired.
words.example_cn: 被飓风损坏的大多数建筑都修好了。

words.example_en: An emergency supply of food reached the area.
words.example_cn: 一批应急食品运到了该地区。

words.example_en: Damaged roads made it hard to deliver food.
words.example_cn: 受损的道路使送食物变得困难。

words.example_en: Call an emergency number in an emergency.
words.example_cn: 紧急情况下要拨打急救电话。

words.example_en: During a disaster, the most important thing is to stay calm.
words.example_cn: 灾难中最重要的是保持镇静。

words.example_en: Foreign aid was organised for the affected area.
words.example_cn: 为受灾地区组织了外国援助。

words.meaning_cn: 影响;(疾病)侵袭;深深打动
words.example_en: Half a million people were affected by the flood.
words.example_cn: 五十万人受到这场洪水的影响。

words.example_en: The effects of the disaster lasted for years.
words.example_cn: 这场灾难的影响持续了数年。

words.example_en: Huge waves crashed into the coastline.
words.example_cn: 巨浪猛烈拍打着海岸线。

words.example_en: Homes and cars were swept away by the waves.
words.example_cn: 房屋和汽车被海浪卷走。

words.example_en: Huge waves reached the village in seconds.
words.example_cn: 巨浪几秒钟就到了村子。

words.example_en: The undersea quake struck early in the morning.
words.example_cn: 海底地震在清晨发生。

words.example_en: Ninety percent of the homes were gone.
words.example_cn: 百分之九十的房屋消失了。

words.meaning_cn: 电力供应;能量;力量;权力
words.example_en: After the quake, water, food and power were hard to get.
words.example_cn: 地震后,水、食物和电都很难得到。

words.example_en: The town was left without electricity for days.
words.example_cn: 小镇断电了好几天。

words.example_en: With the tireless efforts of its people, a new city was built.
words.example_cn: 凭着人们不懈的努力,一座新城建了起来。

words.example_en: Two thirds of the people were dead or injured.
words.example_cn: 三分之二的人死亡或受伤。
